description: Source code defining classes for Google Vertex AI chat models, including ChatVertexAI and GoogleVertexAI_ChatModels, with methods for initialization and configuration.

classes.name: ChatVertexAI

methods.name: revertToOriginalModel

methods.description: Sets multi-modal options for the chat model.

methods.name: setVisionModel
methods.description: Configures the model for vision input if not starting with 'claude-3'.

methods.name: loadMethods.listModels
